tasks.description: Prisma schema: enums QuizStatus/QuestionType/ResultsVisibility/AttemptStatus/ScoringPolicy and models Quiz, Question, QuizAttempt, QuizAnswer (@@id[attemptId,questionId]), QuizAccommodation exactly per PRD FR-1, plus relations/indexes from system-design §2 and back-relations on Course/User. Migration via `prisma migrate dev --create-only`, then append raw SQL partial unique index quiz_attempt_one_in_progress_uq (status='IN_PROGRESS') and add a schema comment pointing to it. Never use db push (ADR-2).

Zod validators (client-safe): quizSettingsSchema (superRefine availableUntil>availableFrom, timeLimit<=window; timeLimit 1-300|null, maxAttempts 1-10), questionSchema discriminatedUnion on type (points 0.5-100, 2-8 options, >=1 correct for MC, 1-10 accepted), answerResponseSchema (type-agnostic, text<=10000), manualGradeSchema {pointsAwarded step 0.5, feedback?} (field name per api-contracts, NOT `points`), accommodationSchema, reorderSchema. Unit tests.

Pure core grading.ts (no Prisma client; import dec/fixed2/Decimal from @/server/assignments/grading-math): gradeAnswer, needsReview (A8 derived rule), normalizeShortAnswer, computeDeadline, attemptLimit, resultsVisible, canPublish, applyScoringPolicy (HIGHEST/LATEST/AVERAGE over GRADED), seededShuffle (string hash + mulberry32), ANSWER_GRACE_MS=30000. Unit tests per system-design §6 incl. FR-2 example ({A,B}->0,{A}->2) and ' Photosynthesis '.

Student serializers toStudentQuiz/toStudentAttempt (incl. serverNow, options shuffled via seededShuffle(attempt.id) when shuffleOptions)/toStudentResult built by explicit allow-list; correct/explanation only when resultsVisible && showCorrectAnswers. Unit test walks output recursively asserting no `correct` key before visibility (AC-7).

Integrations: add notification types quiz.published (ACADEMIC, STUDENT, defaultEmail false) and quiz.results_released (ACADEMIC, STUDENT+PARENT, defaultEmail true); register('quiz', resolver) file context — course manager, or course viewer when quiz PUBLISHED.
access.ts: assertCanAccessAttempt(user, attempt, {write}) — owner (write), manager via assertCanManageCourse, linked PARENT read-only only when resultsVisible; otherwise NOT_FOUND.

attempt-service.ts: startOrResumeAttempt (window/limit CONFLICTs, cuid up front, seeded questionOrder, frozen deadlineAt, P2002 -> re-read and resume; 201 vs 200 signal), getAttempt (ensureNotExpired), saveAnswer hot path (1 attempt read + 1 upsert, no Quiz/Question load; deadline+30s -> auto-submit + CONFLICT 'Time is up'), submitAttempt(id,{auto}) idempotent via status claim, ensureNotExpired, gradeAnswerManually (points<=question.points, audit after commit), recomputeAttempt(tx,id), getStudentQuizScore (returns isPractice; no endpoint).

quiz-service.ts: listCourseQuizzes (role-shaped teacher/student/parent; A2 'missed'), createQuiz, getQuizForManager (locked/publishProblems/totalPoints), getQuizForStudent, updateQuiz (DRAFT->PUBLISHED conditional updateMany + canPublish VALIDATION_ERROR + notify quiz.published after commit), deleteQuiz (CONFLICT if attempts), add/update/delete/reorderQuestions behind edit lock (FR-10 message), regradeQuiz (one $transaction, skip gradedById!=null, recomputeAttempt, audit), releaseResults (MANUAL claim + notifyStudentAndParents + audit), upsertAccommodation (audit).

analytics.ts: getQuizAnalytics (count/mean/median/max/min/avg time, 10-bucket histogram with 100% in last bucket, per-question %correct, avg points, option distribution with most-chosen wrong option) and analyticsCsv via toCsv (student, attemptNumber, score, one column per question).

maintenance.ts: autoSubmitExpiredAttempts(now) (IN_PROGRESS, deadlineAt < now-30s, cap 200, submitAttempt auto) and sendAfterCloseResultsReleased(now) (claim resultsReleasedAt null->now, notify only when count=1). Wire both into internal email dispatch route after sendDueReminders, each in own try/catch + logger.error.
Quiz & question CRUD route handlers (thin: withHandler -> requireUser/requireRole -> Zod -> one service call -> ok/paginated), shapes per api-contracts.json.
Teacher action route handlers: regrade, release-results, analytics (?format=csv -> text/csv), accommodations PUT.
Attempt route handlers: POST start/resume (201/200), GET attempt, PUT answer (response has no grading data), POST submit (returns StudentResult), PUT manual grade.

Integration tests (Vitest + test DB): autosave 409 after deadline+30s and attempt auto-submitted; GET auto-submits expired attempt; concurrent start returns one attempt; double submit no-op; regrade changes auto-graded answers but not manual ones; maintenance pass idempotent.

Course Quizzes tab + list: course-tabs.ts entry (no sidebar entry, A1/FR-37); server page with requirePageRole + course access; CourseQuizzesView (teacher DataTable + New quiz; student Upcoming/Available/Completed/Missed; parent read-only completed results); new/page.tsx creates DRAFT and redirects to edit. mui-mcp lookup first (ADR-7).

Quiz player: take/page.tsx (start screen + ConfirmDialog, ensureNotExpired), QuizPlayer (sticky header, mm:ss timer from deadlineAt+serverNow, red <2min, aria-live at 5:00/1:00, Chip save pill, LinearProgress, Radio/Checkbox/TextField per type, all-on-one-page or paged navigator with client-only flags, submit ConfirmDialog with unanswered count, mode='preview' no-op), useAutosave (800ms debounce, localStorage queue 'quiz-attempt:<id>', 5s retry, 409 -> clear + route to result, merge queue on mount). mui-mcp lookup first.

Builder question list: QuestionList (dnd-kit SortableContext of MUI Cards + Up/Down keyboard fallback, add via type picker defaulting to SINGLE_CHOICE, duplicate, delete, disabled controls + tooltip when locked) and QuestionEditor (per-type editors: options with correct Radio/Checkbox, Enter adds option, accepted-answers list, essay guidance, MarkdownEditor + FileUpload context 'quiz').

Builder shell: edit/page.tsx (manager-only), QuizBuilder (running points total, Publish with canPublish errors, lock banner + Regrade button, Preview as student via QuizPlayer mode='preview'), QuizSettingsPanel (DateTimePicker window, Switch/Select/TextField settings, accommodations DataTable of enrolled students with note that changes apply to new attempts only, A7).

Result page quizzes/[quizId]/attempts/[attemptId]: assertCanAccessAttempt, toStudentResult (score, %, per-question correctness, response, feedback, correct answers/explanations if allowed) or 'Submitted — results will be available later.' Used by student, parent, teacher.

Manual grading: grade/page.tsx (manager-only, ensureNotExpired on load) + QuizGradingWorkspace (Tabs By student / By question, points TextField step 0.5 max=question points, feedback, override on auto-graded answers).

Analytics UI: analytics/page.tsx + QuizAnalytics (StatCards, x-charts BarChart 10 buckets — first x-charts use, mui-mcp lookup mandatory, per-question DataTable with most-chosen wrong option highlighted, CSV link to ?format=csv).
Seed: three quizzes per FR-36, idempotent by (courseId, title); attempt scores computed with grading.ts.

E2E (Playwright): teacher builds 4-question quiz incl. essay and publishes -> student starts, answers, page.reload(), answers persist, submits -> teacher grades essay -> student sees results; axe check on player.

notes: Dev gate (ADR-7/NFR-4): mui-mcp useMuiDocs->fetchDocs before every UI component; unreachable => stop and report.
Dev gate (ADR-2): use prisma migrate, never db push (partial unique index).
grading.ts holds deadline/scoring/shuffle per system-design §3.1 (ADR-3 split files not created).
manualGradeSchema field is pointsAwarded (api-contracts), not points.
FR-37 produces no code (A1); NFR-10 is a scope fence.
